stances_toward.note: Claimed, not controlled: Russian forces hold South Ossetia since the August 2008 war, with 'borderisation' fences moving the line (RUSI cites the 2015 Tsitelubani markers affecting the Baku-Supsa pipeline). The Georgian parliament abolished the Temporary Administration of South Ossetia on 17 December 2025, which Jamestown reads as meeting a Russian demand. Bond grievance: the 2008 war.
